decisive_spans.text: a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl

response.rationale: The patient's history of a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl and the presence of an SDHB gene variant strongly support Hereditary Paraganglioma-Pheochromocytoma Syndrome. While Paraganglioma is also supported, the specific genetic finding and the location of the mass make the hereditary syndrome a more precise diagnosis.
